title: fireflymcf project (*.ffproj.json)
description: An ordered list of recipe ops compiled against one stock mcf.bin. Generated by `python3 -m fireflymcf.ops_doc`; `fireflymcf ops NAME` describes each op.

base_sha256.description: sha256 of the owner's stock mcf.bin

build_name.description: the name the boot menu lists; distinct from stock

id.description: unique; later ops reference it as {"ref": id}

root.description: page root object index or {"ref": op_id}

switch_values.description: optional {switch child base: value} for the walk

expect.description: records and their absolute box: {select, x?, y?, w?, h?}

snapshot.description: true: record the walk for a later unchanged_since

unchanged_since.description: id of an earlier snapshot of the same root

except.description: selects left out of the unchanged_since comparison

channel.description: G12 channel to drop from the master (0-255)

child.description: object index or {"ref": op_id} of the attached child

set.description: geometry fields to write, keys from x/y/w/h -> new int value

expect.description: prior values to validate before writing (keys must be in set)

optional.description: set keys allowed to be absent on the record

dgn.description: expected DGN of the entry (asserted, not written)

from_instance.description: re-pin: the instance the entry currently compares (asserted); omitted, the entry must be an unpinned 0xFF one

color.description: [r, g, b] triple or {"index": n} palette index

allow_container.description: recolour a card of controls on purpose

move_display_list.description: move the status variable (coach-proven; the old channel's G12 OUTPUTS row then reports the new one) instead of retargeting the indicator

object.description: object index to remove (the child, not the attaching parent)

park_y.description: y coordinate written into every attach record; must be >= 480

object.description: stock object index holding the label

old.description: current text (or unique substring of the field)

align.description: which side the same-size pad goes. 'right' preserves a left-aligned label's indent; use 'center' when the record centres its text, where trailing pad shifts it visibly

allow_grow.description: permit a relocating grow when the text does not fit

screen.description: destination screen id (14 = INVERTER / CHARGER SETTINGS)

dgn.description: expected DGN of every edited binding

slot.description: new font slot value to write

expect.description: prior selector value to validate ('inherit' for 0xff)

group.description: address a stock group directly (bypasses target)

slot.description: new font slot value for the icon's R38 selector (slot, char and/or blank_caption required)

char.description: single character to write at the icon's label offset (slot, char and/or blank_caption required)

blank_caption.description: blank the object's other wtype-11 caption with spaces (slot, char and/or blank_caption required)

current.description: the character the icon to change shows now, when the object holds several icon records

x.description: button box left x on the compact frame

enable_wire.description: 8-byte payload (hex) sent once on a 1-s hold

group_pool.description: where the command group comes from: the first free slot (the heater, byte-stable), or newbutton.hold_safe_groups (a group GuiCode does not drive; holds on GuiCode-driven 136/137 were dead on a coach)

button.description: {ref: add_aes_batt_heat op id}: take the button's w/h/text from that op (default: the stock 122x173 'Batt Heat')

mask.description: bit(s) of the heater var's 2-bit field that mean 'on' (1..3)

clear_faults.description: also set GENERAL_RESET's clear-faults bits (0x05, rvc2mqtt's reset frame) instead of reboot alone (0x01)

batteries.description: battery objects: {"object": N} or {"ref": op_id} (an add_voltage_battery op's clone)

style.description: contactor mark: the white glyph with the number raised, or an outline_rgb outline

off_colour.description: [r, g, b] indicator colour when off

font.description: caption font slot; selector must be the 0xff inherit default

allow_commanded_channel.description: opt out of the channel-collision check

allow_named_output.description: acknowledge an output the G12 OUTPUTS list names for a load

rows.description: [{caption, value: {ref}|{slot}, format: {width, places}, unit}], top to bottom

pen_x.description: right edge of the values (they right-justify)

parent.description: object the readouts attach to: an object index or {ref: op_id}; default 829 (aes_card_layout's frame)

gate.description: {'ref': op_id, 'field': name}: read the gate cell index from an earlier op's handle

value_slot.description: the gate cell index, given directly

dx.description: mark x offset from the host's flow origin

dy.description: mark y offset from the host's flow origin

page_root.description: screen root to re-walk in verify (4 = HOME)

expect.description: [x, y] the mark must land at on that page

preview_slots.description: {slot: value} the re-walk needs to reach the host

font.description: font slot the character is drawn from

page.description: page name (resolved via cli._resolve_page_root) or object index

w.description: width written to every box/icon/caption/touch geometry field

h.description: height written to every box/icon/caption/touch geometry field

fill_cell.description: placeholder mode-7 colour-table index for fillA and every value_slot

preview.description: draw the mockup's example state as static text (no receive side, no GuiCode)

refresh.description: staleness class of the 14 entries (1 = 10 s)

arrow.description: {slot, char}: the up-arrow glyph an earlier install_glyph op installed

accent.description: [r, g, b] of the needs-blocks wheel tiles and the SHORT ON BLOCKS strip. The default was pale amber (0xE6,0xA0,0x28) before it became orange, so a project that sets neither accent nor orientation no longer reproduces an image built under the old default

orientation.description: "rear": the van drawn rotated 180 degrees (front at the bottom, driver on the right), each wheel's tile beside its rotated wheel; "front": the original drawing

controls.description: add the Blocks-carried stepper (- / + send 18EFFF9F 4C5604/4C5603) and Zero Level (3-s hold sends 19FDE89F and 19FDEA9F); three new groups, four new bindings

arrow_probe.description: DIAGNOSTIC: draw the tiles' arrow three ways plus once outside the arms (`levelpage.ARROW_PROBE`) to find what cuts it on the coach

repaint.description: repaint-on-change: each LEVEL/popup value sits in a two-arm switch on a toggle the routine flips when the value changes, so a narrower value never leaves the old one's edge (verified on the coach)

popup_background.description: the setup popup paints its own background, header bar and 'LEVEL SETUP' title (a screen change clears to white, seen on the coach)

setup.description: move Zero Level and the Blocks-carried stepper into a LEVEL SETUP popup on screen 12 (`levelsetup`), with block height and tolerance steppers and AUTO; the LEVEL page gets a Setup button and a read-only Carried. Needs `controls`

geometry.description: add Wheelbase and Track rows to the LEVEL SETUP popup (-/+ 0.5 in on level-sensor ops 0Bh-0Eh, repeating while held; values from record 04h bytes 1-4), in a taller five-row dialog. Needs `setup`

arrow_last.description: draw each wheel tile's up arrow after its two readouts: a readout repaints its background over about 50 px left of its pen whatever its field width (seen on the coach), which wiped the arrow drawn before it

arrow_probe2.description: DIAGNOSTIC: one tile draws its arrow last, another paints its readout backgrounds green/blue (`levelpage.ARROW_PROBE2_*`)

fill_safe.description: narrow the wheel tiles' readout fields (layers 1, lift 3 characters) so no background fill can cover the arrow or leave the tile in any measuring class (`readoutfill`); 10+ layers / 10.0+ in show dashes. False keeps the original (2, 4)

stepper_dgn.description: the 18-bit DGN the - / + send on: 0x0EFFF (J1939 proprietary-A, the first form flashed) or 0x1EFBF (the RV-C custom DGN addressed to the sensor at BF: 19EFBF9F, in use since 2026-09-28); needs `controls`

screen.description: target screen object (the AES ELECTRICAL sub-view)

button_x.description: absolute x of the Low Volts button (box/label/touch)

button_y.description: absolute y of the Low Volts button (box/label/touch)

donor.description: AGS Trigger panel object to source records from

button_w.description: button width; None (default) reuses the shared 105x50 child 285 via a wtype-5 attach (byte-identical to before). Setting it (or button_h/label_font) shrinks the control by authoring an absolute box+label on the AES side instead

label_font.description: font slot for the 'Low Volts' label; None keeps font 14 (reuses shared child 285). Setting it shrinks the text

title_font.description: font slot for the 'Triggers:' title; None keeps the donor's font (14)

title_text.description: override the title text; None keeps the donor's 'Triggers:'. The donor is still located by 'Triggers:'

title_center.description: when true, ignore title_x and centre the title horizontally over the button face

compare_byte.description: +5: low nibble = payload byte compared, high nibble = 2-bit mask select (0 = whole byte)

slot.description: icon/value font slot; must be a 4bpp font

char.description: the character whose stub entry gets repointed

y.description: glyph y-bearing; must equal (cell_height - glyph_height) // 2 unless force_y

rows.description: pixel rows, one hex digit (0-f) per pixel, all rows equal length

force_y.description: skip the bearing-convention check (for v-align-1 records)

profiles.description: the 10 ink-profile (kerning) bytes, 5 left then 5 right; omit when authoring new artwork

flag.description: record byte +0x0e bit 0, the measurer's bearing flag

claim_block.description: also claim a char whose glyph is its font's solid placeholder block (icon font 24's unused slots), provided no record draws that char in that font

from.description: object index or {"ref": op_id} holding the control

at.description: {x, y}: absolute top-left of the moved control

source_root.description: optional: measure only this source page root

dest_root.description: optional: measure only this destination page root

switch_values.description: optional {switch child base: value}: measure only this set

slot_values.description: optional {slot: value}: measure only this set

screen_object.description: object index the hold opens (NOT a screen id)

preserve.description: [[touch_id, object], ...] arms the stub must keep

pump_section.description: {"ref": op_id} of an add_pump_auto_off op; when given, the compact frame carries its Water Pump section

link_indicator.description: {'ref': add_option_follower op id}: wire the Pump Link button to that op's 0/1 display cell as a wtype-6 switch over dark/lit arms

off_at_zero.description: show 'Off' instead of '0 Min' when the Auto Off minute count is 0 (the disabled setting), via a wtype-6 switch over two readout arms

target.description: object index or {"ref": op_id} of the button shell

off_colour.description: [r, g, b] indicator colour when off

allow_commanded_channel.description: opt out of the channel-collision check

allow_named_output.description: acknowledge an output the G12 OUTPUTS list names for a load

x.description: the Low Volts checkbox switch anchor x on the compact frame

y.description: the Low Volts checkbox switch anchor y on the compact frame

watch_channel.description: G12 output instance whose status bit is watched

target_channel.description: G12 output instance the follower drives

selector.description: the DGN_CONFIG selector the new toggle writes/gates on

gate_mask.description: mask ANDed with the selector's receive slot before the gate test: (slot & gate_mask) == gate_on_value. 0xFFFF (default) is the whole-halfword test; narrow it when the selector's word packs more than one field

gate_on_value.description: the value the masked gate slot must equal for the follower to transmit and the row to read checked

row_x.description: the row's switch/checkbox anchor x on the OPTIONS page

row_y.description: the row's switch/checkbox anchor y (the clear slot)

link_group.description: the config-toggle group id this op must create or adopt for the 0xEE toggle (optionrow.REUSE_GROUP_SLOT); any other value refuses

minutes_default.description: recorded for provenance; the routine's actual fallback is the fixed pumpauto.MINUTES_DEFAULT (30)

allow_disable.description: lower the minute floor from 5 to 0, so 0 is a legal setting that disables Auto Off, and emit the borrow recovery a '-' press at that floor needs

sub.description: subtracted after the mask, clamped at 0 (RV-C AC current is 20*A + 32000: sub 32000, shift 1 gives tenths of an amp)

draw.description: false: allocate the cell and chain the routine but draw nothing; the handle's display_slot is for another op to draw (add_card_readouts); excludes page/x/y/format/donor

cell_slot.description: FEED AN EXISTING display cell (a stock readout's value_slot) instead of allocating one and authoring a widget; excludes page/x/y/format/donor

silence.description: with cell_slot: runtime addresses of stock 2-byte stores to that cell to replace with nop, so the fed value is not overwritten each tick

page.description: page context (not used to resolve the parent)

parent.description: object index the clone is attached to

x.description: target centre x for the clone battery body

y.description: target row y0 for the clone battery (matched to the chassis label's own y0)

live_repaint.description: retarget the clone's enrolled wt5 container (on the parent) to watch the live coach-48V cell 209 instead of the chassis cell 205 it inherited from the template, so the panel repaints the WHOLE House battery (number AND fill) live -- the mechanism the stock chassis uses

rescale_donor.description: repoint donor 443's fill colour/level onto the clone's fresh 48V cells, so the ELECTRICAL coach battery stops showing always-100%-green (its stock cells are driven on a 12V scale a ~53V pack saturates); 443's own enrolled containers already watch 209, so the fill then goes live too

watch_channel.description: G12 output instance whose status bit is watched

target_channel.description: G12 output instance the follower drives

gate_option.description: stock caption of the gating OPTIONS row (object 46)

gate_label.description: the row's new caption (same-size rename only)

gates.description: list of {ref|dgn+..., mask?, value?}; all must hold

dgn.description: DGN low-16/18-bit or a name (DC_DIMMER_STATUS_3, DGN_CONFIG, DC_DIMMER_COMMAND_2)
